title: rubus pedunculosus var. aitchisonii
intro: Rubus pedunculosus var. aitchisonii, commonly known as Himalayan Raspberry, is a variant of the Rubus pedunculosus species, which belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is a shrub native to the Himalayan region, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The Himalayan Raspberry is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
